references.text: Moses emphasizes the importance of following God's word, which is a treasure of wisdom and knowledge, like the new and old treasures a scribe in the kingdom of heaven brings forth.
The call to seek the Lord and his riches, which can be compared to the treasure a scribe in the kingdom of heaven can bring forth.
Jesus speaks about fulfilling the Law and the Prophets, which resonates with the idea of bringing forth both new and old treasures from God's word.

The parables about the treasure of the kingdom of heaven and the pearl of great price illustrate the value of God's kingdom, like the value a scribe brings forth from his store of new and old teaching.

The author of Hebrews speaks of God speaking through the Son, which represents the treasure of the new covenant compared to that of the old covenant, as a scribe in the kingdom of heaven would appreciate.
